name: Fourier Feature Encoding
definition: A preprocessing step reformulating the network as $F_{\Theta} = F^{\prime}_{\Theta} \circ \gamma$, where $\gamma$ encodes inputs using Fourier features to provide high-frequency features, addressing the neural network bias toward low-frequency functions.
summary: Fourier Feature Encoding maps scene coordinates to high-frequency sinusoidal features to overcome neural network spectral bias, distinguished by its use of fixed, non-trainable bases rather than learned embeddings.
